qualifier: spindle midzone through contractile ring to midbody abscission
name: Cytokinesis from spindle midzone to midbody abscission
rationale: All members concern the late-mitotic division of the cell (midzone, Rho-driven actomyosin ring, septins, furrow, abscission), whereas confusables centre on spindle checkpoint/kinetochore signalling or ESCRT nuclear envelope resealing.

name: Fc-gamma receptor-triggered phagocytosis
rationale: Members describe FcgammaR activation driving actin and phospholipid remodelling of the phagocytic cup, unlike confusables on inhibitory Fc receptor signalling, ADCC, hypersensitivity or BCR signalling.

qualifier: germinal centre with ICOS-driven T follicular helper cells
name: Germinal centre B and T follicular helper cell activation
rationale: Members cover B cell signatures, germinal centre B differentiation, ICOS co-stimulation and Tfh differentiation, distinguishing the theme from generic B cell, naive B and plasma cell modules.

name: Meiotic chromosome alignment and poleward segregation
rationale: All three members concern positioning and moving chromosomes on the (female) meiotic spindle, while confusables cover meiotic checkpoints, meiosis I spindle positioning or chromosome condensation.

name: EGFR-driven ERBB signaling and transactivation
rationale: Members centre on EGFR (GRB2/SHC1 events, EGFR-ERBB2, gastrin transactivation, overexpression inhibition), whereas confusables centre on ERBB2, ERBB3 or ERBB4 signalling via PLCG1, GRB7 or PI3K.

name: Glutamate and aspartate uptake and transport
rationale: All members concern glutamate/aspartate membrane transport and homeostasis (EAAT diseases, astrocytic uptake, VGLUT3), while confusables concern GABA and glycine transport and metabolism.

core: Caspase-8 and RIPK1 cell death signaling
name: Caspase-8–RIPK1 cell death including TRIF-induced necroptosis
rationale: Members cover caspase-8 dimerization, c-FLIP and inhibition, TRAIL, RIPK1 necrosis and TLR3/TRIF-induced death, distinguishing them from FasL/BID extrinsic apoptosis, TBK1-IRF3 activation or necroptosis regulation terms.

name: Nuclear pore–coupled mRNA export and gene gating
rationale: Members describe mature mRNA export through the nuclear pore and pore-linked transcription (gene tethering at the periphery), versus confusables on rRNA/tRNA export, cytoplasmic mRNA decay or splicing and transcription machinery.

qualifier: TRAF3/TRAF6 to IRF and NF-kB, and viral antagonism
name: RIG-I-like receptor signaling via TRAFs and viral antagonism
rationale: Members cover RLR signalling through TRAF3/TRAF6 and FADD/RIP1 to IRF7/NF-kB plus viral modulation by RSV and SARS-CoVs, unlike confusables on IRF3/TBK1 interferon induction or ISG effector responses.

name: GPI anchor and glycosphingolipid synthesis and transport
rationale: Members span GPI anchor synthesis/attachment, ganglioside and galactosylceramide synthesis and glycolipid transfer, separating them from lysosomal glycosphingolipid catabolism, protein palmitoylation and nucleotide-sugar transport.

qualifier: de novo purine and pyrimidine synthesis with pyrimidine catabolism
name: De novo purine and pyrimidine synthesis with pyrimidine catabolism
rationale: Members cover de novo IMP/AMP/GMP and UMP/UTP synthesis plus pyrimidine and deoxynucleotide breakdown, distinct from confusables on deoxynucleotide synthesis, NDP/NTP interconversion and ADA/PNP purine salvage.

qualifier: OATP organic anion transporters and drug ADME
name: OATP-mediated drug and xenobiotic membrane transport
rationale: Members describe SLCO/OATP organic anion transport, Rotor syndrome and drug ADME transport, differing from SLC22 organic ion transport, phase I/II xenobiotic metabolism and bilirubin conjugation.

qualifier: glutamate, aspartate, alanine and malate-aspartate shuttle
name: TCA cycle anaplerosis via glutamate, aspartate and alanine
rationale: Members connect glutamate, glutamine, aspartate and alanine metabolism to TCA intermediates, the malate-aspartate shuttle and gluconeogenesis, unlike confusables on oxidative phosphorylation, broad amino acid catabolism or urea cycle.

name: Centrosome duplication, microtubule nucleation and spindle orientation
rationale: Members concern centriole duplication, MTOC nucleation/anchoring, astral microtubules and spindle positioning in asymmetric division, distinguishing them from neuroblast division, tubulin modification, ciliogenesis and mitotic centrosome maturation.

name: Basement membrane assembly with collagen crosslinking and integrin–laminin binding
rationale: Members cover basement membrane assembly, collagen trimerization, crosslinking and anchoring fibrils, and integrin/laminin/DDR binding, unlike confusables on elastic fibres, hemidesmosomes, collagen biosynthesis or the dystrophin complex.

name: Calcium ATPase pump regulation in striated muscle
rationale: Members concern inhibition of SR and plasma membrane calcium pumps with effects on muscle fiber type and survival, whereas confusables concern cardiac contraction, heart rate and other channel regulation.

qualifier: biliary and intestinal sterol and phospholipid
name: ABC transporter–mediated biliary and intestinal lipid efflux
rationale: Members describe ABCB4/ABCB11/ABCG5/ABCG8 lipid export and their cholestasis/sitosterolemia defects, distinct from lipoprotein remodelling, chylomicron assembly and bile acid synthesis confusables.

qualifier: germ cell, oocyte and somatic cell maturation
name: Germ cell, oocyte and gonadal somatic cell maturation
rationale: Members span germ cell migration and meiotic entry, oocyte and follicle maturation, Sertoli/Leydig development and gonadotropin responses, unlike confusables on hormone secretion, ovulation/luteinization or male sex determination.

name: Adherens junctions and apical–basal epithelial polarity
rationale: Members cover cadherin adherens junction assembly and maintenance together with apical-basal polarity, apical constriction and EMT restraint, separating them from desmosome/hemidesmosome, CDH processing and tight-junction confusables.

qualifier: lipoxygenase and cytochrome P450 (HETE, EET, omega-hydroxylation)
name: Lipoxygenase and P450 eicosanoid and fatty acid oxygenation
rationale: Members describe LOX and CYP epoxygenase/omega-hydroxylase products (HETEs, EETs, hepoxilins, lipoxins) and fatty acid transport, distinct from leukotriene, PAF and specialized pro-resolving mediator confusables.

name: Golgi and endosome membrane tubulation and budding
rationale: All three members concern membrane deformation into tubules or vesicles at Golgi and endosomes, whereas confusables concern recycling, Rab/ARF signalling or Golgi structure.

qualifier: respiratory burst against bacteria and fungi
name: Neutrophil respiratory burst and killing of bacteria and fungi
rationale: Members concern superoxide/respiratory burst regulation and neutrophil killing of Gram-negative bacteria and yeast, versus confusables on antimicrobial peptides, Gram-positive defence and degranulation.

name: Bicarbonate transport by SLC4 family transporters
rationale: Members concern bicarbonate transporters including SLC4A4 defects, unlike CFTR, CO2/ammonium, cation-chloride or SLC26 anion exchanger confusables.

name: 5- and 15-lipoxygenase products including lipoxins
rationale: Members describe 5-HETE, 15-HETE and lipoxin biosynthesis, distinct from omega-3 resolvins/protectins, 12-LOX hepoxilins and leukotriene confusables.

qualifier: cholesterol, ubiquinol and vitamin K-dependent carboxylation
name: Isoprenoid synthesis to cholesterol, ubiquinol and vitamin K function
rationale: Members span mevalonate/prenyl diphosphate synthesis, cholesterol, ubiquinol and vitamin K metabolism with gamma-carboxylation, distinct from vitamin E, dolichol and CYP-disease confusables.
